text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin loved running more than anyone 
else. Under the watchful eyes of countless 
racing fans, she claimed a brilliant 
victory in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The racecourse erupts with excitement over 
the "Ines Call." Ines Fujin responds to it 
with all her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Family, friends, fans—everyone dreamed 
through her. And Ines Fujin enjoyed that 
dream more than anyone else...
